title: [P1] Obtain native encoded-wire census evidence for the six BF16_K1 gamut cases

labels.name: P1
labels.description: A gate that cannot catch its own defect, or a wrong number a decision reads

body:
Remaining outcome: qualify routed BF16_K1 q256 960/1088/1152 and dense BF16_K1 q256 1152/1408/1792 on the issue's image-X, eager, resident, TP1 scope, as these cases are priced.

Inspected main a2269f9b packages contract v67. In src/tessera/serving/runtime_contract.json, BF16_K1 already has reader range [256,4096], but its attested_rungs_q256 and attested_wire are empty and no BF16 lane cells are published. Reader support, allowable run tables and experimental dispatch registrations are not serving qualification. Do not create another CPU planning slice: #734's census_plan.py, tools/plan_native_census.py and tests already exist.

Execution prerequisite, not a physical ask: obtain the recorded PrismaBuild qualification/adoption/fresh exact-tuple decision required by Rob's October 4 instruction before any missing native/serving run. Custody remains with v6 Kernels Lead and integration with v6 Review and Integration Lead. Bind the decision to the actual source, image, toolchain, encoded-wire inputs, geometry and launch identity; the ordinary release-gate GPU arm is not automatically image-X evidence. If those prerequisites are unavailable, record the exact missing artifacts through the existing PENDING-GPU/issue handoff and leave acceptance unmet. This item grants no GPU/adoption authorization.

After approval, reuse permitted cached encodes where valid, otherwise obtain the scoped encoded-wire inputs through the existing export/prepared-bundle path. Census actual loads and native execution in decode and prefill/batch for all six cases. Retain receipts, input/source identities, preparation details, expected-versus-observed launch identities and failures. A compact substitute, absent library, unsupported record, zero covered modules or agrees:null must not count as the requested native evidence. Keep deployment bindings in existing configuration, not application constants.

Acceptance: each requested, priced BF16 case has independently reviewable exact-scope native census evidence suitable for W3, or is explicitly recorded as still unqualified; absence is not completion. Coordinate library/substitution findings with supplied open tessera#1239 and unsupported-reader findings with #1245 rather than duplicating those fixes. No broad kernel rewrite, numerical change, timing campaign, new pricing logic or PrismaQuant runtime-pin change is included. Research inspected files only; no new checks or native runs were executed.
